INSERT INTO dead_letter_queue (
            newsletter_issue_id,
            subscriber_email,
            attempt_count,
            last_error,
            failed_at
        )
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT (newsletter_issue_id, subscriber_email)
        DO UPDATE SET
            attempt_count = excluded.attempt_count,
            last_error = excluded.last_error,
            failed_at = excluded.failed_at
